newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian energy companies welcome cold weather.
newsitem.headline: Belgian energy companies welcome cold weather.

text.p: The cold weather which has swept across Europe and brought temperatures in Belgium down to record lows, making people push up their heaters to the maximum, was welcomed on Friday by oil company Petrofina and electricity firm Electrabel.

"It is obvious, not withstanding taxation on income, when the weather is cold profitability of heating products is much higher...so it will have a positive impact," a Petrofina spokesman told Reuters.
"In the past temperatures in Belgium have been below minus 10 degrees (celsius), but not for 10 consecutive days," he said.
Electrabel spokesman Patrik De Vos, welcoming the greater use of heating, said however the impact on profits would be small.

"The impact is really very marginal," De Vos said. "For private consumers consumption goes up three or four percent during these 10 days of extreme cold weather, but over the whole year it's really very marginal".
-- Paul de Bendern, Brussels Newsroom +32 2 287 6816, Fax +32 2 230 7710
